scope: Twelve original Moving Edges reward still candidates for three existing authored layout designs across four themes. No runtime, catalog, saved/earned binding, production-count or release adoption.
generation: Twelve independent text-only calls in concurrent batches of three, three and six. No generation retry, edit, original crop, stretch, resampling or re-encoding. Eleven outputs are 1774×887; Survey Wheel Ukraine is 1773×887 despite the same 1774×887 request. Review derivatives use a proportional full-frame fit.
rightsScope: Original fictional AI-generated project illustrations. No reference images were supplied to generation, no copied game assets or named artist imitation. FPV includes recognizable Ukrainian drone/military context without graphic violence or operational claims. Ukraine uses broad craft/material inspiration; Retro equipment and Coupa-themed cooperative spaces are invented. No historical/product accuracy, exclusive-rights or human-quality certification.

layoutAuthority.source: Separately owned Moving Edges geometry; fixed cues supplied by its author before generation.
layoutAuthority.limits: Narrative composition cues only; perspective scenes are not collision maps or gameplay/native evidence.

review.agent: All twelve actual generated originals inspected visually; concrete deviations are recorded per image. Review-thumbnail readability is checked separately.
review.root: Root review is separately attributed; no runtime or human-fun approval is inferred from source verification.
review.limits: Source artwork only; no browser, partial-reveal, device, gameplay, animation or full-quality certification.
